statement: CISA adds at least one Citrix vulnerability other than CVE-2026-88771 and CVE-2026-88772 to the KEV catalog between 2026-09-29 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: The CISA KEV catalog carries an entry with vendorProject Citrix, a CVE ID other than CVE-2026-88771 or CVE-2026-88772, and a dateAdded value between 2026-09-29 and 2026-12-31 inclusive.
failure_condition: No Citrix entry other than the two named CVEs has a KEV dateAdded value within 2026-09-29 to 2026-12-31.

statement: The FBI publicly attributes the 387.5 million dollar Bitget theft to North Korean actors between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: An FBI press release or IC3 public service announcement dated between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-30 attributes the Bitget theft to the DPRK or a named DPRK cluster such as TraderTraitor or Lazarus.
failure_condition: No FBI or IC3 publication dated within the window attributes the Bitget theft to North Korea or a DPRK-linked cluster.

statement: The 10-year Treasury constant-maturity yield for 2026-12-31 is above the packet-date level. Reference: 5.27 percent on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DGS10 value for 2026-12-31 is strictly greater than 5.27. Reference: 5.27 percent on the packet date.
failure_condition: The DGS10 value for 2026-12-31 is 5.27 or lower.

statement: WTI crude spot prints at or above 110.00 dollars on at least one day between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-30. Reference: 95.60 on the packet date.
resolution: FRED series DCOILWTICO shows at least one daily value of 110.00 or higher dated 2026-09-29 through 2026-11-30. Reference: 95.60 on the packet date.
failure_condition: Every DCOILWTICO daily value dated 2026-09-29 through 2026-11-30 is below 110.00.

statement: The US government formally restricts diesel or distillate fuel exports via a Federal Register document published between 2026-09-29 and 2026-12-31.
resolution: The Federal Register publishes a presidential document or agency rule, dated 2026-09-29 through 2026-12-31, that prohibits, licenses, or caps exports of diesel or distillate fuel from the United States.
failure_condition: No Federal Register document published in the window imposes a prohibition, licensing requirement, or cap on US diesel or distillate exports.

statement: A Federal Register document modifying US tariffs on products of China is published between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: The Federal Register publishes an executive order, proclamation, or USTR notice dated 2026-09-29 through 2026-11-30 that changes duty rates on goods of Chinese origin.
failure_condition: No Federal Register document published in the window changes US duty rates applicable to goods of Chinese origin.

statement: US and Iranian officials hold direct talks, confirmed by both governments, between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-15.
resolution: Reuters or AP reports that a direct US-Iran meeting occurred between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-15, and both the US government and the Iranian government publicly acknowledge that meeting.
failure_condition: No direct US-Iran meeting within the window is acknowledged by both governments.

statement: The Ethiopian federal government and Tigrayan forces announce a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities between 2026-09-29 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: Reuters and AP each report that the Ethiopian government and Tigrayan armed forces agreed or declared a ceasefire or cessation of hostilities dated within 2026-09-29 to 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: No ceasefire or cessation of hostilities between the Ethiopian government and Tigrayan forces is agreed or declared within the window.

statement: At least one of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford is charged with a terrorism or explosives offence between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-12.
resolution: The CPS or Counter Terrorism Policing announces, dated 2026-09-28 through 2026-10-12, a terrorism or explosives charge against at least one person arrested in the RAF Fairford investigation.
failure_condition: No person arrested in the RAF Fairford investigation is charged with a terrorism or explosives offence within the window.

statement: Hurricane Polo makes landfall on the Baja California peninsula at hurricane intensity between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-06.
resolution: NHC public advisories or tropical cyclone updates for Polo state a landfall on the Baja California peninsula with maximum sustained winds of 64 knots or higher, dated within the window.
failure_condition: Polo does not make landfall on the Baja California peninsula at hurricane intensity within the window per NHC products.
